section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses self-report inventories as a method for assessing creative achievement and talent. It describes several such inventories, including a checklist devised by Torrance (1972) for post-high school achievements, a checklist by Holland and Nichols (1964) spanning six domains, and the extensive Creative Behavior Inventory compiled by Hocevar (1979). The text focuses on the design and scope of these measurement tools rather than reporting on specific studies or their findings.
